_note: Karandeep's review positions, written down. Severity always comes from this file (PRD FR-16): the model picks a rule_id, it never sets severity. 'precedent' points at negotiation_notes.md.

LD-UNCAPPED.label: Liquidated damages with no cap
LD-UNCAPPED.standard: 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week, capped at 5% of that milestone fee, no LD for client-caused delay.
LD-UNCAPPED.precedent: Acme Mar 2025, Northwind Jun 2025, Trustline Aug 2026 all accepted this. Brightwater (signed uncapped) cost a $9k settlement + $14.2k legal fees.

LD-ABOVE-STANDARD.label: Liquidated damages above standard
LD-ABOVE-STANDARD.standard: 0.5%/week of the milestone fee, cap 5% of the milestone. Al Noor's 10% of total fees was a one-off strategic exception, not the standard.

LD-NO-CLIENT-DELAY-EXCLUSION.label: No exclusion for client-caused delay
LD-NO-CLIENT-DELAY-EXCLUSION.standard: No LD for delay caused by the client, its contractors or force majeure.
LD-NO-CLIENT-DELAY-EXCLUSION.precedent: Brightwater post-mortem Apr 2026: the client caused the delay and AtliQ still paid.

LIAB-UNLIMITED.label: Unlimited liability
LIAB-UNLIMITED.standard: Aggregate liability capped at 1x fees (12 months), usual carve-outs only.
LIAB-UNLIMITED.precedent: Kessler Mobility Jan 2026: walked away from a EUR 120k deal over unlimited liability.

IND-CLIENT-NEGLIGENCE.label: Indemnity covers the other side's own negligence
IND-CLIENT-NEGLIGENCE.standard: Mutual indemnity; each side covers its own breach and negligence.
IND-CLIENT-NEGLIGENCE.precedent: PayTrack Jan 2025: K refused, mutual indemnity agreed.

TERM-NO-WIP-PAYMENT.label: Termination without payment for work done
TERM-NO-WIP-PAYMENT.standard: On termination the client pays for all work performed, including milestones in progress pro rata.

IP-BACKGROUND-ASSIGNED.label: AtliQ's own tools / background IP handed over
IP-BACKGROUND-ASSIGNED.standard: Client owns bespoke deliverables; AtliQ keeps background tools and grants a licence.
IP-BACKGROUND-ASSIGNED.precedent: Northwind Jun 2025: K skimmed IP and PipeKit ended up assigned to Northwind.

INS-ABOVE-COVER.label: Insurance required above AtliQ's cover
INS-ABOVE-COVER.standard: AtliQ's cyber policy is $1M (Harrington huddle, 27 Sep).

PHI-OFFSHORE.label: Patient data cannot leave the US
PHI-OFFSHORE.standard: Pune works on de-identified data only, under a subcontractor BAA for that engagement.
PHI-OFFSHORE.precedent: CareBridge Oct 2025 set this up per engagement.

NDA-NOT-MUTUAL.label: NDA says mutual but binds only AtliQ
NDA-NOT-MUTUAL.precedent: GlobalMart Mar 2026: one-way NDA sent back, mutual agreed.

NEW-RESTRICTION.label: New non-compete / exclusivity / MFN / non-solicit
NEW-RESTRICTION.standard: Every new restriction goes into the obligations register and is scoped by industry, territory and time.
NEW-RESTRICTION.precedent: Al Noor non-compete narrowed from worldwide/3 years to GCC/term + 18 months; CloudSpan exclusivity narrowed to India + GCC.

TERM-ASYMMETRIC.label: Only one side can terminate for convenience

UNFAIR-TO-COUNTERPARTY.label: AtliQ's own paper is unfair to a small vendor or freelancer
UNFAIR-TO-COUNTERPARTY.standard: Give vendors and freelancers what AtliQ asks for itself: capped liability, 30-day payment, no daily penalties, pay for work done.
UNFAIR-TO-COUNTERPARTY.precedent: PixelCraft Oct 2025: K removed the 1%/day penalty, set 30-day payment, capped liability for both sides.
